def factor_tail_downside_var_ratio(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    returns = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    downside_returns = returns.clip(upper=0.0)
    downside_var = downside_returns.pow(2).rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    total_var = returns.pow(2).rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    ratio = downside_var / total_var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ratio.name = "factor_tail_downside_var_ratio"
    return ratio
description: Extreme Risk & Fragility mechanism: stress accumulation manifests as a shift in the realized return distribution toward the left tail. Instead of measuring level volatility, this factor computes the proportion of trailing 60-day squared returns coming from negative daily returns. A high downside variance ratio indicates persistent negative asymmetry and rising fragility, orthogonal to common industry/size effects.
